messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Hosted API (us-east-1) p95 > 10s, queue growth +1.2k in 2m, autoscaler failing to create GPU nodes. Trigger=queue_length>500 for 3m :rotating_light:

maria_ops: I'm taking it. seeing GPU pool saturated on 'g1-us-east-1a', autoscaler logs show cloud API 429/403 creating nodes -> quota/rate-limit errors.

jonathan_oncall: adding context: we deployed an autoscaler policy change at 03:12 (infra-deploy) that tightened scale-up concurrency. could be contributing. grabbing customer top offenders now.

eva_infra: confirmed: autoscaler config 'max_scale_up_ops' was lowered from 10 -> 3 in the 03:12 rollout to reduce noisy scale churn. that reduces our parallel attach attempts.

maria_ops: top offender = customer_id=rtux-rtu-prod sending sustained 30k req/s with long seq lengths (avg tokens 600). they're pinned to redwood-medium-v1 (GPU).

customer-success: pinging CS: we've alerted the customer, asked them to enable client-side backoff. waiting reply (cc @account-team). :phone:

jonathan_oncall: quick mitigation options (ranked):
1) enable overflow routing -> CPU/slower model for rtux (instant)
2) temporarily raise autoscaler parallelism and max nodes (if cloud quota allows)
3) apply per-customer throttling (rate-limit header)
4) route some traffic to Dedicated pool for whitelisted customers

eva_infra: I can request quota bump but cloud says ~15-20m. short-term we should do overflow + per-customer throttling. I'll stand by to approve routing change.

maria_ops: patching routing policy now to overflow rtux -> cpu-slow with full fallback. executing console API call: 

```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/policies" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{
    "selector": "customer_id:rtux-rtu-prod",
    "overflow": {"target":"cpu-slow","percent":100},
    "note":"Emergency overflow for RTU spike"
  }'
```

deploy-bot: deploy/routing-policy #482 started by maria_ops — status: success (3 replicas updated) :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: New autoscaler error sample: 
```
Error: attach_gpu failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient quota for requested GPUs. callId=attach-88a3
 at autoscaler.scaleUp (/srv/autoscaler/main.js:412:23)
 CausedBy: cloud.gpu.api: quotaExceeded
```

maria_ops: after overflow enabled queue -> 1.2k -> 420 in 6m, p95 dropped to ~1.2s, p99 still ~8.5s for long-run requests. some clients still seeing timeouts (504).

jonathan_oncall: next actions: 1) keep overflow in place 2) stake quota bump request (eva) 3) enable soft throttling header for rtux via gateway (reduce concurrency 5x) 4) prepare rollback of 03:12 autoscaler change if scale-up remains constrained.

eva_infra: quota bump request submitted (cloud ticket #CLOUD-9981), approved, provisioning ETA 18m. also temporarily increasing autoscaler parallelism on infra-side from 3 -> 6 (will monitor attach failures).

maria_ops: enabling per-customer soft throttle: 

```
PATCH /gateway/customers/rtux-rtu-prod
{ "concurrency_limit": 12, "burst": 24, "reason": "emergency backoff" }
```
Applied. initial effect: concurrent streams dropping from ~2200 -> ~420 for that customer.

customer-success: customer replied: they saw spike due to a campaign misconfiguration, rolling back rollout on their side and enabling client backoff. they asked for grace period. :pray:

maria_ops: monitoring: overall errors down to 3.4% (from 12%), queue length trending down. still seeing elevated p99 for heavy sequences.

jonathan_oncall: root cause hypothesis: abrupt RTU customer burst + an autoscaler config change that reduced parallel scale-up ops -> combined with cloud GPU quota limit produced failed scale-ups -> backlog and throttles. Impact window ~03:12-04:05. approx 12% of hosted customers experienced errors/timeouts, major spike for rtux only.

eva_infra: long-term actions noted: revert overly small scale-up concurrency setting, add safety buffer to autoscaler for quota errors, add per-customer dynamic throttles, and expand runbook for CPU overflow for long sequences.

maria_ops: logging summary to incident page and tagging for postmortem. Will attach logs and timeline.

jonathan_oncall: handing off to night oncall @sashi_oncall for monitoring and follow-up. Key things for handoff: routing overflow remains live, quota provisioning in progress (ETA ~18m), per-customer throttle applied, watch for p99 > 10s or queue growth > 200.

sashi_oncall: ack — I'll take watch for 2h. If p99 > 10s escalate to infra-eng and page oncall-emerg. Adding myself to incident page. :eyes:

maria_ops: final note for handoff: incident severity set to Sev2, customers impacted noted in incident doc, CS doing outreach. I'll update postmortem draft after stabilization.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue stabilized, p95 back to normal ~120ms, closing active pager. Follow-up actions documented in incident tracker: IN-2026.

jonathan_oncall: great work team — thanks for quick mitigations. we'll run a retro tomorrow to tighten runbook. :thumbsup:
